note: How the conformance tester drives radiopost-po. {bin} is the program, {home} a fresh directory for each test; {base}, {listen}, {admin}, {door} and {smtp} are addresses the tester chose. `code` prints the code first; `dns` prints the RP-1 §7.1 records, one a line; `door` is the URL of the door's MTA hook, which the tester calls in the MTA Hooks draft's shape (stage, envelope, rawMessage, senderAuth).
